fact: tests/agents/test-no-general-purpose.sh pins every roleType("...") mention per file in tests/agents/role-type-manifest.txt and maps each Task({ block's description to its expected role (EXPECT).
recommendation: When intentionally adding/removing/changing roleType mentions run `bash tests/agents/test-no-general-purpose.sh --write-manifest` and review the diff; add an EXPECT entry for any new Task({ block.

fact: Regex classes can define 'done' for commands, flags and version strings, but not for prose claims: each review round found another phrasing (#62 plan review escalated 3 times).
recommendation: For prose, run one broad search (e.g. git grep -niE 'priming|knowledge base'), read every hit by hand and record a verdict table; keep the prose regex as a regression guard of known phrases only.

fact: A repo-wide wording guard's negative self-test must include one fixture line per forbidden pattern. In #67 reviewers twice found a newly forbidden phrase with no fixture, so removing it from the list would not have failed any test.
recommendation: Whenever you add a pattern to a guard, add a matching bad line and a `bad.md:N:` assertion. Then mutation-check it: delete the pattern on a scratch copy and confirm the self-test fails.
